name: clean-yard-equipment
about: A sound square ad: a white tractor at a fuel island at night, the kit's green plate. Our overlay over the checker's clean-truck-yard photo, cut to 1:1.

truth.how: nothing planted: a night scene, the truck legible, the kit's colours

subject_legible.reason: A brightly lit white sleeper tractor at a fuel island stands out sharply against the night sky and reads as a truck instantly.

words_match_picture.reason: A sleeper-cab tractor at a truck-stop fuel island at night suits a plain call for Class A OTR drivers, though the headline is generic.

hierarchy_reads.reason: The white headline on the dark green plate is large and read first, but 'Apply now' is plain bold text with no button shape.

looks_like_kit.reason: The plate is the brand's dark green with white lettering and the white truck fits; no logo was supplied, so none is missing.
